description: This file sets up and runs an AI-powered conversational bot using Pipecat framework, integrating speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and language model services, with transport configurations and event handlers.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents the sequence of processing steps for the bot.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates the pipeline, its parameters, and execution logic.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the pipeline execution.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages the execution of the pipeline, including handling signals.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds the context for the language model interactions.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Aggregates user and assistant responses within the LLM context.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the bot with specified transport and arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, creating transport and starting the run.
